features:
🌹 RoseHub – Spin a Baddie Script 🌹

Released 04.03.2026

Main Features

🌹 Auto Buy System
Automatically purchase dice, potions and eggs with customizable targets or buy all available items instantly.

🌹 Auto Dice Spin
Fully automated dice spinning with adjustable intervals.

🌹 Weather Smart Roll
Automatically equips the best dice and only rolls during selected weather events.

🌹 Fast Egg Hatch
Automatically hatch eggs with an optional fast hatch bypass.

🌹 Auto Sell Baddies
Automatically sell baddies based on selected rarities.

🌹 Auto Rebirth
Automatically rebirth at set intervals for faster progression.

🌹 Auto Quests and Rewards
Automatically claim quests, playtime rewards and index rewards.

🌹 Auto Place Best Baddies
Automatically places the best baddies on your field.

🌹 Gem Shop Automation
Automatically buy gem upgrades and gem shop items.

🌹 Auto Fuse
Automatically fuse baddies from your inventory.

🌹 Traveling Merchant Auto Buy
Automatically purchases items from the merchant when it appears.

🌹 Wheel Auto Spin
Automatically spins the reward wheel.

Utility

🌹 Anti AFK
Prevents disconnections while farming.

🌹 Discord Webhook Alerts
Sends notifications when rare baddies are obtained.

🌹 Weather Alerts
Detects weather events and displays notifications.

🌹 Config System
Save and load your settings.
